Ahead, beyond the mist, something answered: three brief flashes, then darkness.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市终于放轻了呼吸。高架桥上只剩零星的车灯，像迟归的萤火滑过灰蓝色天际。便利店的白光落在空荡街角，环卫工推着车慢慢走过，扫帚声惊起檐下一只麻雀。远处的写字楼仍亮着几扇窗，无人知道里面守着怎样的梦。豆浆铺揭开蒸笼，第一缕热气撞上清凉的风。夜色正在退去，而这座城还未完全醒来。","w03":"- Recursion is when a way of solving a problem uses a smaller version of the same problem.\n- It must have a stopping point, like reaching the last matryoshka doll, so it does not go on forever.\n- Imagine opening nested boxes: you open one, repeat with the box inside, and stop when you find the prize."}
